extension.summary: POV lists with small posters, for Passe-partout Custom's View all grid.
extension.description: Runs POV's own list code and adds a small TMDb poster (342 px wide) to every title as "gridposter", so a page of 20 small prints does not decode 20 full-size posters. POV's own poster stays for the info page. One page of 20 per call, no "Next page" item. Used by skin.passepartout.custom; not meant to be opened on its own.
